policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 Astra rolled out beginning Sept 3 (phased)
items.summary: O Academy materials say GPT-6 Astra begins a phased rollout starting September 3, 2026, as part of a broader ChatGPT update cycle.

items.headline: O: Axios—expanded policy/security footprint amid scrutiny
items.summary: Axios reports O expanding its policy team and convening security leaders ahead of planned cyber-related announcements, amid heightened government attention.

items.headline: O: Astra broad release at phased cyber capability threshold
items.summary: O said Astra will soon launch broadly, but some most powerful cyber capabilities will initially be limited to trusted testers after reaching a “critical” cybersecurity threshold.

items.headline: O: Path to Astra—delays tied to added cyber safeguards
items.summary: O described delaying parts of Astra’s development/release while strengthening and testing protections against cyber misuse and unauthorized model actions.

items.headline: G: Raises $650M to scale inference cloud
items.summary: G announced $650M in growth capital to accelerate expansion of its AI inference cloud, aimed at scaling deployment via partners and data-center operators.

items.headline: G: G becomes NVIDIA cloud partner
items.summary: G announced it became an NVIDIA cloud partner, positioning future customers to get more capacity and latest inference technology “without changing a line of code.”

items.headline: V: Board addition as space-based pharma manufacturing accelerates
items.summary: V announced pharmaceutical leader Mikael Dolsten will join its board as space-based pharmaceutical manufacturing scales.
